text: Great explanation — although only a week or so ago I wouldn't have understood a lot of it. Knowing how transistors work helps a lot: [VIDEO]
This is a good explanation, but I prefer the one by Ben Eater: How semiconductor works: [LINK] How a transistor works: [VIDEO]

As someone who is not an electrical engineer, I found Ben Eater's videos on how semiconductors work and how transistors work interesting and enlightening. How semiconductors work: [LINK] How a transistor works: [VIDEO]

Aside from his basic 8-bit CPU, Ben Eater goes into how transistors work too: [VIDEO] . Once you've got transistors, his videos walk you through making gates. Once you've got gates, he switches to the 74xx series and builds a CPU.
